This is a collection dedicated to the backs of girl's thighs.

There are plenty of collections focusing on girl's feet and asses, but surprisingly few people pay attention to their thighs, especially the beautiful curves on the back of the thigh.
The Japanese term "足フェチ" is relatively broad and can refer to an attraction to legs and feet in general, whereas the English term "foot fetishism" specifically refers to feet. There seems to be much less specific terminology and far less attention devoted to girl's thighs.
It's difficult to find pictures focusing exclusively on the back of the thigh, so most of these pictures also include other fetish themes.

The pics in this collection span roughly from 2000 to 2026. I've done my best to remove recent AI-generated images, although some may have slipped through.

"Sara's Collection" includes all the relevant pics I've collected over the years. I try to collect as many as possible, but unfortunately, I've lost quite a few due to accidents.

"Sara's Picks" is a smaller selection of the pics I personally like the most.

I'll post my personal picks for "Back of Thigh" later.

If you have any good pictures that aren't included in my collection or picks, you're more than welcome to send them to me.
